question: What division of the eight octads is sought to be fully known?
premises: There is a division of eight octads.
This division is to be fully known.
The knowing is sought without end.
inference: The speaker seeks to fully know the division of the eight octads in its entirety.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: And to fully know the division of the eight octads in all its extent.
